caseName: Southern Life & Health Insurance v. Turner
caseNameFull: Southern Life & Health Insurance Co. v. Turner

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Ala. Motion of American Council of Life Insurance for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Pacific Mut. Life Ins. Co. v. Haslip, 499 U. S. 1 (1991).
